Officer's narrative
On arrival at the scene in Pearland, Texas, I found two vehicles that had come together in a low-speed head-on
collision. Driver 1 was standing beside a vehicle with front-end damage that matched the impact described by both
drivers. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder and said the belt tightened sharply during the collision. The injury
appears consistent with the kind and force of this crash. Driver 2 reproted no earlier damage to the vehicle, and I
found no information suggesting any prior damage to either car. Passenger was in Driver 2's vehicle and reported no
injuries. Driver 1 could not say clearly where in the vehicle they were seated at the moment of impact, and that detail
remains unclear. Scene photographs confirm the positions of both vehicles and some of the damage. No independent
witnesses were located. Driver 1 is nmaed on the insurance policy covering the vehicle involved.
